title: BGP: Add BGP-LS BGP Egress Peer Engineering (rfc9086)
description:
- Add BGP-LS BGP Router Identifier TLV (516)
- Add BGP-LS BGP PeerNode/PeerAdj/PeerSet SID TLVs (1101/1102/1103)
- Modified from error to warning for unsupported BGP-LS NLRI TLVs

Attached a sample pcap file: [bgp-ls-epe.pcapng](/uploads/7170cb617a78d711cad68d2ef91bef7a/bgp-ls-epe.pcapng)

notes.body: @martin.r.mathieson what do you think ? check_hf tools will not be try to fix this ?

I'm not that familiar with what tools/checkhf.pl does..

'tools/check_typed_item_calls.py --consecutive' will flag this as a warning.

This is probably a matter of taste - I might prefer to have only one item that gets added, but then change the displayed text.

@alagoutte / @martin.r.mathieson 

I ran the tools and here is the list of warnings in packet-bgp.c
```
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-bgp.c: - mask 0xffff appears consecutively - labels are "Group Mask" and "Group"
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-bgp.c: - filter "bgp.ls.tlv.te_default_metric_value" appears consecutively - labels are "TE Default Metric (old format)" and "TE Default Metric"
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-bgp.c: - mask 0x80 appears consecutively - labels are "IS-IS Up/Down Bit" and "Overload Bit"
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-bgp.c: - filter "bgp.ls.sr.tlv.peer.sid" appears consecutively - labels are "PeerNode SID TLV" and "PeerAdj SID TLV"
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-bgp.c: - filter "bgp.ls.sr.tlv.peer.sid" appears consecutively - labels are "PeerAdj SID TLV" and "PeerSet SID TLV"
```

Because unique display filter seems to be recommended, I'll modify the diff so that unique display filter would be used for Peer SID TLVs instead.
